description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符。更多信息，请参考文档《[如何保证幂等性](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence)》。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, refer to References: [How to ensure idempotence](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence).
The description of the authorization server.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam update-authorization-server-description --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --authorization-server-id iauths_system --description description_of_authorization_server --client-token abc123xyz --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam UpdateAuthorizationServerDescription --region cn-hangzhou --Description description_of_authorization_server --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --AuthorizationServerId iauths_system --ClientToken abc123xyz
